text:
riley: Quick sync — finalizing X + LinkedIn cadence for the benchmark + webinar in two weeks. Need copy, hero GIF, thumbnails, and inbound routing to SDRs. Prefer native threads not screenshots.

samira: Agreed. Proposed cadence: Day 0 AM X hook (3 tweets), 10am LinkedIn longform, Day 0 PM deep-dive thread (4 tweets + chart image). Day 1 reminder + customer quote.

noah: For headline metric, legal cleared two options: "~35% lower cost per response" or "sub-40ms p95". We'll A/B test. Which gets more lift?

taylor: Eng audiences = latency. Biz audiences = cost. Plan: run cost-first to 40% impressions, latency-first to 60%, evaluate at 3 hours. If CTR delta >20% flip allocation.

creative: Asset list: hero GIF 16:9 (<=4MB), 1200x628 thumbnail, LinkedIn cover, alt text for each. Need final copy by Tue for Wed GIF turnaround.

riley: Ops — can you spin a unique HubSpot form + shortlink and add hidden fields for campaign_variant and source=social? Also want a param for traffic_bucket.

ops-bot: HubSpot endpoint created: https://hooks.example.com/hubspot/warp-3636. Shortlink: https://go.redwood.ai/warp (captures utm_source=social & campaign_variant). Hidden fields added: campaign_variant, source, traffic_bucket. Test payload: {"email":"test+social@redwood.com","campaign_variant":"A","source":"social","traffic_bucket":"paid"}.

noah: Great. Also ensure shortlink accepts `?variant=A` so we can tag the CTA.

ops-bot: Shortlink accepts variant param, example: https://go.redwood.ai/warp?variant=A. Scheduler set to America/Los_Angeles. Posts will publish as native X threads.

paid-media: Recommend $900 day-of split 65% AM / 35% PM. Targeting: infra engs, platform PMs, ML infra titles in NA. LinkedIn boost $350 for longform. Conversion = form submit.

sdr-bot: SDR routing: real-time Slack DM to #sdr-inbound on each signup + daily CSV at 8:30am to sdr@redwood. Tag leads who clicked GIF as "hot". Include HubSpot link in digest.

samira: Copy drafts (short):
- riley: "Cut inference cost ~35% for routine prompts. See our benchmark + demo: https://go.redwood.ai/warp"
- riley: "Serve responses faster — sub-40ms p95 in our tests. RSVP: https://go.redwood.ai/warp"

noah: I'll QA metric language vs bench and sign off before publish. No posts until I approve.

riley: Also, community follow-up: export top commenters after 24h for outreach. SDRs + community team to handle.

creative: Noted. I'll upload GIF storyboard by Mon AM, first cut Tue. Alt text file to follow.

riley: Perfect. I'll create a Notion checklist with owners and deadlines. Ping here when assets or approvals land. :rocket:
